title: LYON NEW YEAR CELEBRATION – 3rd Edition
description:
🎉💜 LYON NEW YEAR CELEBRATION 3rd EDITION 💜🎉
Dancing friends,
The LION KINGS EVENTS team present the 3rd Edition of the
🎉💜LYON NEW YEAR CELEBRATION 💜🎉
This Festival has an international vocation and is ideally located in Lyon, a large city in the south-east easily accessible by rail and airplane.
The 5 nights and 4 days will take place in a place that will live up to your expectations.
The best teachers, DJs, photographers, videographers are there.
As you can see, we focus on QUALITY above all, for your greatest pleasure.
📅 From Wednesday, December 30, 2026, to Monday, January 4, 2027, join us for 5 days of dancing, workshops, and parties…
🎉 “Lyon is where the VIBE is.”

✨💜 VENUE 💜✨
⚜️ Venue : MARKADAS MEYZIEU
⚜️ Address : 20 avenue du Dr schweitzer, 69330 Meyzieu
⚜️ Distance from the airport or train station “Lyon Saint Exupery”:
You must take the Rhone Express (you can buy your tickets in advance here: https://www.rhonexpress.fr/fr_FR/) then get off at “Meyzieu zi” (10mn)
⚜️ Distance from the train station “Lyon Part Dieu” :
If you arrive at Part Dieu station, take the T3 tram towards Meyzieu les Panettes then get off at the “Meyzieu zi” stop (25 mins)

1) Click on the link below :
🎟️ Ticketing: https://my.weezevent.com/lyon-new-year-celebration-edition-3 |
2) Pay for the name change fees
3) Send us an email to
newyear.namechange@orange.fr
with the ticket of your name change fees + complete name and email of the new buyer.
The new buyer will receive his pass within 72h.
